name: ebola
remarks: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) — Entry-Point Controller Module
Two-layer architecture: this controller assigns species and exposure probability,
then delegates to submodules under ebola/ for the full clinical pathway.
Viral species is the most important top-level parameter because CFR, available
therapeutics, and vaccine options differ sharply by species:
Zaire ebolavirus (EBOV):     CFR ~69-88%; mAb114 + REGN-EB3 approved; ERVEBO licensed
Sudan ebolavirus (SUDV):     CFR ~40-60%; no approved therapeutics or vaccines (2026)
Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV): CFR ~30-50%; no approved therapeutics or vaccines (2026)
Species distribution default (85/10/5) models a Zaire-dominant outbreak scenario.
Adjust for Sudan- or Bundibugyo-specific outbreak drills.
If ebola_species is pre-set by an external scenario engine, the module respects
it and skips the distributed assignment. Similarly, ebola_exposed=true bypasses
the population-level prevalence gate.
Prevalence gate (0.5%) is a general-population prior. Set higher for outbreak
scenarios or use ebola_exposed=true to seed specific patients.
References:
- WHO Ebola fact sheet 2025; WHO 2026 Bundibugyo disease outbreak notice
- CDC Ebola disease basics, clinical features, lab guidance
- WHO therapeutics guidance (mAb114, REGN-EB3 for Zaire EVD)
- Design brief: Designing a Synthea Module for Ebola (2026)
EVD affects all ages. Guard on age >= 1 to exclude neonatal period.
After passing, check for externally seeded exposure before prevalence gate.
0.5% prevalence gate for general-population runs.
Increase for outbreak scenarios; decrease for background endemic baseline.
If ebola_species was set by an external scenario engine, skip assignment.
If not pre-set, fall through to distributed species assignment.
Default species mix for a generic Zaire-dominant outbreak scenario.
Tune for country-specific or single-species outbreak drills.
